summary: Feed s149_double to IDS is degraded: 2 high-severity faults detected - 9.6% TCP packet drops and 63.9% VXLAN-encapsulated traffic. IDS requires both directions and full payload but is missing segments and cannot inspect inner traffic.

findings.root_cause: SPAN/mirror oversubscription or packet broker ingress buffer drops before the IDS - 254 of 2644 TCP packets (9.6%) show gaps/retransmissions indicating missing data in transit, well above 1% threshold. Tool overload is healthy, so loss is upstream of the tool port.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS TCP stream reassembly fails, signatures and anomaly detection miss attacks across gaps, causing false negatives and incomplete session logging.

recommended_fix.why: Passive TAP delivers lossless, line-rate copy unlike SPAN which drops under load; eliminates upstream packet loss before broker/IDS.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is forwarding VXLAN-encapsulated traffic without stripping outer header - 1779 of 2782 frames (63.9%) remain inside VXLAN, so IDS only sees outer VTEP/IP/UDP.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS cannot parse inner Ethernet/IP/TCP and payload for 63.9% of traffic; detection rules, IDS signatures and application decoding fail on encapsulated traffic, blinding visibility to east-west/lateral movement.

recommended_fix.why: Stripping VXLAN at the broker exposes inner frames to the IDS which needs full payload inspection, restoring L2-L7 detection coverage without changing tool.
